The owner() getter returns a non-zero address (the deployer). The bug returns address(0) for every instance, violating this for any contract deployment.

The owner() getter should return the address that was originally set as the owner (the deployer), but the buggy version incorrectly returns msg.sender, causing it to reflect the caller rather than the stored owner.

For any caller, c.owner() must always return the same address that was stored during construction, but the mutant returns msg.sender, so a non-owner caller will see a different result than the true owner.
